cases.sentence: Авимелех, ___ Герара, послал за Сарой и взял ее к себе.
cases.explain: Царь renames Авимелех in apposition, so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Это я удержал тебя от ___ против меня.
cases.explain: The preposition от governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Теперь верни жену ___, потому что он пророк.
cases.explain: The verb вернуть (give back to someone) takes its recipient in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Авимелех привел мелкий и крупный скот и вернул ему его ___ Сару.
cases.explain: The verb вернуть takes its direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Авимелех, царь Герара, послал за ___ и взял ее к себе.
cases.explain: The preposition за in the sense 'to fetch/send for' governs the instrumental case.
The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Он жил пришельцем в Гераре, и там сказал о своей жене Саре, она моя сестра.
reading.question: What did Abraham say about Sarah in Gerar?
reading.explain: The text says Abraham said of Sarah, 'она моя сестра' — she is my sister.

reading.ru: Но Бог явился к Авимелеху ночью во сне и сказал ему
reading.question: How did God warn Abimelech about Sarah?
options: He appeared to him in a dream at night
He sent a plague on his house
He sent an angel in the daytime
reading.correct: He appeared to him in a dream at night
reading.explain: The text says God 'явился к Авимелеху ночью во сне' — appeared to Abimelech at night in a dream.

reading.ru: На другой день рано утром Авимелех собрал всех приближенных и рассказал им, что случилось, и они сильно испугались.
reading.question: How did Abimelech's men react when he told them what happened?
reading.explain: The text says 'они сильно испугались' — they were greatly afraid.

reading.ru: Тогда Авимелех привел мелкий и крупный скот, рабов и рабынь, дал их Аврааму и вернул ему его жену Сару.
reading.question: What did Abimelech give Abraham along with Sarah?
options: Sheep, cattle, and male and female servants
reading.correct: Sheep, cattle, and male and female servants
reading.explain: The text lists sheep, cattle, male and female servants that Abimelech gave Abraham.

reading.ru: Авраам помолился Богу, и Бог исцелил Авимелеха и его жену, и рабынь, чтобы они снова могли иметь детей
reading.question: What did God do after Abraham prayed for Abimelech?
options: He healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants so they could bear children again
He sent Abraham away from the land
reading.correct: He healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants so they could bear children again
reading.explain: The text says God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his servants so they could have children again.
